Priya K: quick ping — PR #3124 is ready for merge (tiny rename + formatting). This blocks a customer deploy scheduled for today at 15:00 PDT. Need 1 reviewer + green CI.

Sam B: (code) ```bash
gofumpt -w ./pkg/cache && git add -A && git commit --amend --no-edit
```
